drain.waitingNoLimit: Waiting for running work to finish before installing: {$waited} min. New work is paused.
drain.awaitingOperator: Work is still running after {$waited} min. New work stays paused. Keep waiting, force the upgrade now, or abort it.

agentClients.title: Connected agent clients
agentClients.intro: AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Grok that connect to this install.
agentClients.introRelease: This update ships version {$version} of the DPF agent tools. Each client is checked when it connects. A client that is behind is told and asked to update itself.
agentClients.fingerprintHint: The fingerprint identifies the exact files a client loaded.
agentClients.unavailable: The client list could not be read right now.
agentClients.unavailableHint: It refreshes each time this page loads.
agentClients.noPack: This version of the portal does not include the DPF agent tools, so there is nothing to compare.
agentClients.empty: No agent client has connected yet.
agentClients.emptyHint: A client appears here after its first connection to this install.
agentClients.lastSeenRecent: Last seen within the last hour
agentClients.truncated: Showing the {$count} most recently seen clients.

current.label: Up to date
current.explanation: It loaded the agent tools this update ships.

stale.label: Behind
stale.explanation: It loaded an older copy of the agent tools. It is told on its next connection and asked to update.

below-floor.label: Too old
below-floor.explanation: Its copy is older than this install accepts. It can still read, but changes will be refused once the grace period ends.

undeclared.label: Version unknown
undeclared.explanation: It did not say which agent tools it loaded. That usually means a copy installed before this check existed.

silent.label: Not seen this week
silent.explanation: It has not connected in the last 7 days, so its current copy is unknown.

hostAgent.ok: This computer updates its agent tools on its own.
hostAgent.failed: This computer's automatic update has been failing.
hostAgent.needs-operator: This computer's automatic update is waiting for a person.
hostAgent.opted-out: Automatic updates are turned off on this computer.
hostAgent.offline: This computer could not reach this portal on its last update check.
hostAgent.ahead-of-portal: This computer runs a newer copy of the tools from its source checkout than this portal ships.
hostAgent.busy: This computer is updating its agent tools now.
